tools.name: storecove_discover_participant
tools.description: Check whether a company can receive e-invoices on the Peppol network, and which document types it accepts. Use the scheme and identifier of the company, for example its VAT or company number. Storecove API: POST /discovery/receives.

tools.name: storecove_get_legal_entity
tools.description: Get one legal entity (a company that sends documents), with its Peppol identifiers and settings. Storecove API: GET /legal_entities/{id}.

tools.name: storecove_get_administration
tools.description: Get one administration (an accounting administration under a legal entity), for example the email that receives documents. Storecove API: GET /legal_entities/{legal_entity_id}/administrations/{id}.

tools.name: storecove_get_document_submission_evidence
tools.description: Get the delivery status and evidence of a submitted document, by its submission guid. Use 'sending' for delivery evidence or 'clearing' for clearing evidence. Storecove API: GET /document_submissions/{guid}/evidence/{evidence_type}.

tools.name: storecove_get_purchase_invoice
tools.description: Get one received purchase invoice in JSON form, by its guid (the purchase_invoice guid from a webhook). Storecove API: GET /purchase_invoices/{guid}.

tools.name: storecove_submit_document
tools.description: SENDS a real e-invoice to the recipient over Peppol (or by email, if you give fallback emails). Give the sender legal_entity_id and a base64 UBL or CII invoice file; Storecove parses it and routes it. Sending cannot be undone. Use only after the user confirms the recipient and the invoice. Storecove

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: storecove_discover_participant, storecove_get_administration · Private data: storecove_discover_participant, storecove_get_legal_entity, storecove_get_administration, storecove_get_document_submission_evidence, storecove_submit_document · Public sink: storecove_discover_participant, storecove_get_administration, storecove_get_purchase_invoice, storecove_submit_document.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: storecove_discover_participant, storecove_get_administration · Private data: storecove_discover_participant, storecove_get_legal_entity, storecove_get_administration, storecove_get_document_submission_evidence, storecove_submit_document · Public sink: storecove_discover_participant, storecove_get_administration, storecove_get_purchase_invoice, storecove_submit_document

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
